prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy ash-ecology photograph at a fire-scarred alpine sanctuary at dawn. Show an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1; she shields a field camera while recording one phoenix rebirth from a collapsed ash nest. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance as visible appearance guidance for this original fictional subject. The phoenix visibly reborn from its ash anchor occupies the near midground: one ash nest charred remnant or exhausted former body anchors the prior state; one coherent renewed bird emerges from the same anchor; ash ember filament and feather structures connect through one contiguous transition zone; wing posture falling ash and rising sparks establish upward emergence; heat shimmer scorched surface and displaced ash remain localized around the rebirth. On a separate stone roost, show one complete eagle-lion griffin topology in a side-facing three-quarter view: one eagle head with a hooked beak and forward-facing neck anchors the creature; two feathered wings attach coherently behind the eagle shoulders; the chest and forelimbs retain avian structure or taloned forefeet; lion torso hind legs paws and tail define the rear half; feather fur skeleton and limb junctions transition as one viable anatomy. Use a medium-wide deep-focus composition with readable separation among woman, ash transition, and full griffin. Cold dawn skylight and warm ember bounce share one believable direction, with natural skin and material texture.
